Marseille strike early and seal the win!
Olympique de Marseille secured a 2-0 victory over Toulouse FC in Ligue 1, with Amine Harit opening the scoring in the very first minute before Amine Gouiri doubled the lead in the 25th.
Watch the key moments from Marseille's win at the Stade Vélodrome as they extend their unbeaten run against Toulouse to 25 matches!
